missions.title: Drill
missions.description: Today, our commander officially reported for duty and started our first drill with my assistance.

missions.title: Transport the Injured
missions.description: We received our first mission from HQ - scouting S.F. movements in the area.

missions.title: Investigate Anomalies
missions.description: A few T-Dolls survived the Sangvis ambush. We escorted them back to base.

missions.title: Missing Party
missions.description: With the commander providing cover, the surviving T-Dolls rescued their captured companion.

missions.title: Rescue Signal
missions.description: We found the Sangvis Ringleader lurking in the area thanks to information provided by the T-Doll. It seems to be looking for someone...

missions.title: Operation Uproot
missions.description: We defeated Scarecrow but couldn't stop it from transmitting key information to its associate.

missions.title: Advanced Training I
missions.description: The commander was invited by Miss Helian to participate in a special operation drill.

missions.title: Advanced Training II
missions.description: This drill seems to have something to do with talent scouting. Looks like Grifon has very high hopes for our commander.

missions.title: Advanced Training III
missions.description: The commander asked me about Sangvis Ferri, but I was more concerned about Miss Helian's missing an appointment again...

missions.title: Advanced Training IV
missions.description: So Helian is the very "Mixer Underdog" in Grifon gossips. This doesn't bode well... Should I help?

missions.title: Petite Courrier I
missions.description: MP5 is conveying intelligence under the commander's guidance. Her first stop was WA2000. It went well...sorta.

missions.title: Petite Courrier II
missions.description: MP5 got it touch with P7 and gave her some kind of..."education" (?) on behalf of many other T-Dolls. Whatever that means.

missions.title: Petite Courrier III
missions.description: MP5 ran into a bit of trouble but managed to get out of danger thanks to MG5's threats and G36's bribe. All was well.

missions.title: Petite Courrier IV
missions.description: With the Commander's help, MP5 successfully conveyed the intelligence to Miss Helian. But to us, this is where our work truly begins.
